ab.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.

Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura)
While a friendly Jakhals or Goremongers unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is TITANIC), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

KEYWORDS
JAKHALS and GOREMONGERS units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword.

ab.name: Blood Tithe
ab.description:
Each time a Blood Legions or World Eaters unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend one or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle:

• **Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models from your army have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
• **Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**
Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have the [lance] ability.
• **Boon of Blood [4BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
• **Might of Khorne [5BTP]**
BLOOD LEGIONS units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.
RESTRICTIONS
You can include the Blood Legions units in your army. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:

**Incursion:** Up to 500 pts
**Strike Force:** Up to 1000 pts
**Onslaught:** Up to 1500 pts

No BLOOD LEGIONS model from your army can be your WARLORD.

stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Monster or World Eaters Titanic unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
stratagems.rs: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.t: Cult of Blood – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Monster or World Eaters Titanic unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.t: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.tg: One Jakhals unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
stratagems.rs: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.n: In The Shadow Of Brass Idols
stratagems.t: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly World Eaters Monster units, or within 9" of one or more friendly World Eaters Titanic units, your unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

stratagems.t: Cult of Blood – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Jakhals or Goremongers unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model’s unit is within 6" of one or more friendly World Eaters Monster units, or within 9" of one or more friendly World Eaters Titanic units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Vehicle model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Rhino model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from that model after it has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Vehicle model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your model can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Rhino model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: One WORLD EATERS unit embarked within your RHINO can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your RHINO and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Infantry unit from your army and one friendly Transport that it is able to embark within.
stratagems.fx: If your WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One WORLD EATERS RHINO model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: One KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within your model can make a disembark move and then make a surge move of up to D6+2".
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Blood Legions unit from your army that is within 6" of a friendly World Eaters unit that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If the Boon of Blood ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase, models in your WORLD EATERS unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.when: Start of your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Blood Legions unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one friendly World Eaters unit within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in your WORLD EATERS unit have the [LANCE] ability. If the Daemonic Rage ability is active for your army, then until the end of the phase those melee weapons also have the [TWIN-LINKED] ability.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Blood Legions or World Eaters unit from your army has fought, and one or more enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.tg: That BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit.
stratagems.fx: You gain D3BTP and you can then spend one or more BTP you have to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Blood Legions unit from your army that is on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one friendly Blood Legions unit within 6" of your unit. One destroyed Mounted model, up to D3 destroyed Beast models, or up to D6 destroyed Infantry models are returned to that BLOOD LEGIONS unit with their full wounds remaining.
stratagems.rs: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed Character models to Attached units.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when the last model in a unit is destroyed, before removing it from play. (If that unit is a Transport, any units embarked within that TRANSPORT model must disembark first.)
stratagems.tg: One Bloodletters unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.fx: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of that destroyed model and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, then remove the destroyed model from play.
stratagems.rs: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to an enemy model, if your unit has the Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. If your unit has the Exalted Eightbound keyword and that enemy model is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack instead.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Exalted Eightbound unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.rs: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One World Eaters Possessed unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.tg: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (excluding EPIC HERO units) is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s CHARACTER models’ melee attacks have:

• +1 **A**.
• +2 **S**.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.tg: That WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: When an enemy unit **engaged** with your unit is selected to make a **fall-back move**, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is battle-shocked, -1 from those hazard rolls.

frules.d:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with  this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:

• [LETHAL HITS]
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.

**Example:** Ash makes a Blessings of Khorne roll, getting the following: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6. First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1,2, 2, 2, 3, 4. They then use the two 2s to activate Unbridled Bloodlust. Now that two Blessings of Khorne have been activated, no more can be activated and the remaining dice are discarded.
